cultural.vision_reason: Documentary photograph of a Hopi plaza dance (kachina dancers in traditional regalia) at a pueblo, with adobe buildings and villagers watching — clear evidence of Hopi ceremonial life and dress.

physical.title: photographic print (black and white)
physical.summary:
Photograph (black and white); view of several adobe buildings built around a central plaza, with a group of Hopi people participating in a public plaza dance in the plaza; there are two groups of dancers; the long haired kachina standing in a row, all wearing bearded hair and feather headdresses, aprons, arm ornaments and leg ornaments; and the kachina mana standing in a row opposite the long haired kachina, all wearing cloaks, leggings, moccasins, feathered headdresses, and carrying pouches with seeds in; Hopi men, women and children are standing around the edges of the plaza watching the dancers; Arizona, United States of America 
Gelatin silver print
